components.name: Rust stable toolchain
components.authority: build-time compiler only; no runtime lifecycle or fact authority
components.rollback: rebuild with the prior exact qualified toolchain
components.exit: replace only through a new toolchain profile and complete Host requalification

components.name: Rust builder OCI image
components.authority: offline build stage only and absent from the runtime image
components.rollback: restore the prior digest-pinned builder bundle
components.exit: replace the digest and regenerate SBOM, provenance and all language gates

components.name: Distroless cc Debian 12 runtime OCI base
components.authority: minimal runtime userspace only; no shell, package manager, scheduler, database or device authority
components.rollback: restore the prior qualified runtime base digest
components.exit: replace after OCI, security, compatibility, performance and soak requalification

components.name: Cargo.lock dependency closure
components.license: per-package SPDX license in source/image SBOM and cargo-deny evidence
components.authority: library code only within Host execution isolation; cannot own canonical plugin facts
components.failure: build or the affected public boundary fails closed
components.rollback: restore Cargo.lock and its matching source revision
components.exit: remove or replace crates through lock review, SBOM diff and full Host gates

components.name: Wasmtime Component Model
components.authority: WASI 0.2 pure-transform compilation/execution only; no imports, ambient capability, business state or scheduler authority
components.failure: the exact binding fails admission/readiness or execution with a stable error
components.rollback: restore the prior profile-pinned Wasmtime and recompile exact component digests
components.exit: replace after WIT, Canonical ABI, numeric, fault, performance and old/new qualification

components.name: Tokio
components.authority: bounded asynchronous execution only; HostState retains admission/lifecycle ownership
components.failure: Host readiness/liveness or a bounded invocation fails
components.rollback: restore the Cargo.lock-pinned prior Tokio version
components.exit: replace after complete concurrency, cancellation, resource and soak qualification

components.name: Tonic and Prost
components.authority: versioned protobuf/gRPC transport only; no plugin lifecycle or statistics-current authority
components.failure: public RPC boundary fails closed within total deadline
components.rollback: restore the pinned transport closure and golden protobuf bytes
components.exit: replace after mTLS, framing, retry-disabled, deadline and old/new wire qualification

components.name: Rustls and ring
components.authority: TLS 1.3 mTLS and Ed25519 verification primitives only; configured policy and exact identity remain Host-owned
components.failure: transport or publisher admission fails closed without plaintext/unsigned fallback
components.rollback: restore prior Cargo.lock, trust policy and signed artifact closure

components.name: Serde and serde_json
components.authority: bounded strict startup, manifest, configuration and statistics JSON only
components.failure: unknown, malformed, unsafe or oversized JSON is rejected
components.rollback: restore pinned serialization versions and canonical golden
components.exit: replace after schema, canonical digest and negative-security regression

components.name: Axum health surface
components.authority: startup/readiness/liveness and low-cardinality metrics HTTP only
components.failure: deployment probe fails and stops new work without changing plugin facts
components.rollback: restore the prior pinned Axum closure
components.exit: replace after probe, shutdown, framing and resource qualification

components.name: Vendored protoc
components.failure: build stops before an artifact is emitted
components.exit: replace after protobuf breaking and cross-language golden qualification

components.name: Syft
components.rollback: restore the frozen tool image bundle
components.exit: replace after SBOM equivalence and verifier regression

components.name: Trivy
components.authority: offline vulnerability, secret and configuration scanning only
components.failure: supply-chain gate fails or becomes HOLD when database freshness is invalid
components.exit: replace after policy-equivalent scan and tamper-negative regression

components.name: Cosign
components.authority: offline release-manifest signature and verification only
components.failure: unsigned, untrusted, revoked or tampered evidence is rejected
components.rollback: restore the prior trusted signed manifest and exact artifact digest
components.exit: rotate through the public trust contract without granting runtime authority
